aliases: plaque assay for quantitation of yellow fever virus-neutralizing antibodies
pathogen neutralization assay.readouts: yellow fever virus neutralizing antibody titers measured by plaque reduction

evidence.section: Plaque assay for quantitation of yellow fever virus-neutralizing antibodies
evidence.quote: Anti-YFV neutralizing antibodies were measured by the plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT).

immuno staining assay.readouts: serum antibodies reactive against Japanese encephalitis virus and West Nile virus

evidence.section: Immunofluorescence assay to detect anti-Japanese encephalitis virus and anti-West Nile virus antibodies
evidence.quote: To determine the presence of anti-Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) and anti-West Nile virus (WNV) antibodies in the serum samples, fluorescence microscopy was employed.

flow cytometry assay.readouts: immune cell subset frequencies and intracellular protein staining signals

evidence.quote: Events were acquired on a BD LSRFortessa instrument (BD Biosciences, Bedford, MA, USA) and analyzed using FlowJo software (TreeStar, Ashland, OR, USA).

NK-mediated ADCC assay.readouts: NK cell cytotoxic function including CD107a, IFN-γ, and TNF-α responses against target cells

evidence.quote: In the NK-mediated ADCC assay, target cells are coated with anti-P815 antibodies to serve as the Fc target cells for NK-mediated ADCC.

After hybridization on Human PrimeView Arrays for 16 h at 45°C and rotation at 60 rpm in a Hybridization Oven 640 (Affymetrix), slides were washed and stained with a Fluidics Station 450 system (Affymetrix).
